q1.sampleAnswer: He asked each of them to go and see what a pear tree looked like during winter, spring, summer and autumn.

keyPoints.descZh: 让每个儿子去看梨树在四季的样子
examples: go and see what a pear tree looked like during winter, spring, summer and autumn

q1.rubricZh: 要点：去看梨树在冬春夏秋四季的样子。
q1.explanationZh: 故事开头，爸爸让四个儿子去看梨树在冬天、春天、夏天、秋天分别是什么样。

evidence.quote: he told each of his sons to go and see what a pear tree looked like

q2.explanationZh: 第一个儿子说树光秃秃的、很难看，不是充满希望，所以回答 No, it wasn’t.

q3.sampleAnswer: He had seen many pears on the tree and the joy of a good harvest.

keyPoints.descZh: 看到很多梨和丰收的喜悦
examples: many pears on the tree and the joy of a good harvest

q3.rubricZh: 要点：许多梨；丰收的喜悦。
q3.explanationZh: 第四个儿子说他看到树上有很多梨，还看到了丰收的喜悦。

evidence.quote: I saw the joy of a good

q4.explanationZh: 爸爸说他们都说得对，因为每个人只看到了一个季节。

q5.sampleAnswer: Because each of them had seen only one season in the life of the pear tree.

keyPoints.descZh: 每人只看到梨树生命中的一个季节
examples: each of them had seen only one season in the life of the pear tree

q5.rubricZh: 要点：每个人只看到了梨树的一个季节。
q5.explanationZh: 爸爸解释说，四个人答案不同，是因为每人只看到了梨树一年中的一个季节。

evidence.quote: each of them had seen only one season in the life of the pear tree

q6.sampleAnswer: We should not judge things or people based on one season or one moment in time. It is important to see the bigger picture and enjoy every moment of life. (Any reasonable answers are acceptable.)

keyPoints.descZh: 不能只凭一个季节或一个瞬间评价事物或人
examples: We should not judge things or people based on one moment.

keyPoints.descZh: 要看到全貌、珍惜生活的每个时刻（任意合理感悟）
examples: We should see the bigger picture and enjoy every moment of life.

q6.rubricZh: 开放题：至少两句话，写出合理感悟（如不能只凭一时判断、不要轻易放弃、要看全貌），言之有理即可。
q6.explanationZh: 最后一段说不能只凭一个季节判断一棵树、一个人或人生。写两句话，比如“不要轻易下判断”和“不要在冬天就放弃，因为后面还有春夏秋”。

evidence.quote: You cannot judge a tree, a person or your life by just one season.

q7.explanationZh: tried to 后面接动词原形，cover her face with her hands 是“用手捂住脸”。

q8.explanationZh: looks 后面要接形容词，没有家具房间“看起来不一样”，用 different。

q9.explanationZh: should not be 后面用被动，be judged by 是“被……评判”，学生不该只被考试成绩评判。

q10.explanationZh: because my bus was late 说明因为车晚了，所以“错过”了开始上课，过去时用 missed。

q11.explanationZh: give up hope 是“放弃希望”，后面 that 是同位语从句，说明希望的内容。
q11.tipsZh: give up hope 放弃希望

q12.explanationZh: every time ... goes by 是一般现在时，all the houses 是复数，动词原形 shake（震动）。

q13.explanationZh: 原句是一般过去时，变一般疑问句要用 Did 提前，后面的动词变回原形 shake。

evidence.quote: The third son shook his head.

q14.explanationZh: 感叹句 How + 形容词 + 主语 + 谓语！所以填 How sweet。

q15.explanationZh: 改直接引语，要把 they 变成 you，were 变成现在时 are：“You are all right.”

evidence.quote: The man then said to his sons that they were all right.

q16.explanationZh: 画线部分是原因，用 Why 提问，一般过去时用 did：Why did they get different answers?

q17.explanationZh: 前半句是否定句，后半句用肯定形式：can you？主语 You 所以填 you。

q18.explanationZh: 先找主语 he 和动词 found，后面 that 引出宾语从句：the shelf was full of books。句子是 He found that the shelf was full of books.

evidence.quote: The third son shook his head.
